edges: Lord Silverbridge becomes enamoured with Isabel Boncassen.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The Duke grows closer to his children by the end of the book.
Duke Plantagenet Palliser has a close relationship with his daughter Mary.
Lord Silverbridge proposed to Lady Mabel Grex.
Nicodemus assists Joseph in anointing Jesus' body.
Easter celebrates the resurrection of Jesus.
Mary anoints Jesus' feet with perfumed oil.
Mary is courted by Frank Tregear.
Joanna provided for Jesus out of her resources.
Mary Magdalene provides for Jesus out of her resources.
Maundy Thursday commemorates the Last Supper of Jesus with his disciples.
Gerald gets expelled from Cambridge.
Jesus tells his Twelve Apostles to leave their day jobs and follow him.
Joseph of Arimathea removes Jesus from the cross.
Lady Glencora is the late wife of Duke Plantagenet Palliser.
Jesus was crucified during the events leading up to Easter.
Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead.
Judas objects to Mary's act of anointing Jesus.
Jesus instructs the rich man to sell all he owns and distribute the money to the poor.
Good Friday marks the crucifixion of Jesus.
Garroway speculates on how Jesus and his disciples supported themselves.
